text:
nisha-r: Heads-up  candidate (Omar El-Sayed) on overnight ferry got delayed, ETA now ~11:15 for a 09:00-16:00 onsite loop. He asked if we have a quiet prayer space and whether we can compact the schedule because he needs to catch a 17:30 ferry home. Also asked about a temporary mobile hotspot (no reliable cellular on route).

paul-k: Which interviews can be compressed? I own the 09:30 design and 14:00 system test. We could merge some panels into back-to-back slots.

jamie: I can do a compressed bar-raiser window. We should offer prayer room and vegan meal (he requested halal+vegan). Also loaner hotspot is fine.

recruiter-bot: Profile: Omar El-Sayed, prefers prayer room (no shoe removal required), dietary: halal & vegan, needs hotspot assistance. Contact: omar.e@example.com.

nisha-r: Plan: 1) Create backup Meet for early slots 2) Reserve Prayer/Quiet Room G 10:30-15:30 3) Compress schedule: move 09:30 design -> 11:00 and run 11:00-13:00 as compressed panels, keep 14:00 system test but shorten to 45m 4) Pre-load loaner mobile hotspot and battery pack 5) Provide ferry stipend up to $75 if he misses return. @it-ops-bot can you prep hotspot? @frontdesk-bot, prayer room + vegan halal boxed lunch?

it-ops-bot: Loaner mobile hotspot prepared (device ID HS-42) and battery pack BP-9 reserved at IT desk. SIM configured for same-day use.

frontdesk-bot: Prayer/Quiet Room G reserved 10:30-15:30. Vegan halal lunch ordered (labelled "Omar E"). Visitor prereg done; badge will be at reception. Parking permit code emailed.

calendar-bot: Backup Meet https://meet.google.com/omar-backup created and added to morning invites. Calendar updated: design moved 09:30 -> 11:00, compressed block 11:00-13:00, system test shortened to 45m at 14:00. Added note: "Candidate may need to leave early for ferry at 17:30; please keep feedback concise."

nisha-r: Panel note posted: please be ready to run 11:00 & 11:45 as back-to-back 30m sessions. We will provide hotspot at reception and Prayer Room G for midday. Offer ferry stipend (up to $75) if needed; receipts to hr@redwood.ai.

paul-k: :+1: I can compress my session and use the shorter system test format.

jamie: I'll be onsite for bar-raiser. I'll keep feedback to bullet points.

recruiter-bot: Message queued to candidate:

"Hi Omar  sorry about the ferry. We can compress your schedule and reserve a Prayer/Quiet Room (Room G) 10:30-15:30. A loaner mobile hotspot (HS-42) will be at reception and a vegan halal lunch will be provided. If you miss your return ferry we can cover up to $75 for transit (send receipts to hr@redwood.ai). Backup Meet link if needed: https://meet.google.com/omar-backup. Please confirm whether you'd like us to compact the day."

nisha-r: Sent at 07:55  candidate replied: "Thanks  compacting the day works, I appreciate the prayer space and hotspot. I'll aim to be there by 11:15."

frontdesk-bot: Hotspot HS-42 checked out to candidate on arrival. Badge printed and on-hold for "Omar El-Sayed".

nisha-r: Closing loop  candidate arrived 11:10, used Prayer/Quiet Room G to prep, ran compressed panels 11:00-13:00, system test 14:00 shortened to 45m, left at 16:45 for ferry and stipend not needed. Candidate appreciated the prayer room and hotspot. :white_check_mark:
